HR. POR FALLA EN U. PRUEBAS. SE REPARO FALLA EN MANGUERA DE FLUIDO HIDRAULICO. SE INTENTO PROBAR PREVENTOR SUPERIOR DE ARIETES Y RAM CIEGO OBSERVANDO FUGA EN TAPON DE PRUEBA.'O' RING. PULLED TESTER TO SURFACE AND CHANGED FOR VETCO COMPANY TEST PLUG AND TESTED SPHERICAL PREVENTER 13-5/8"-10M WITH 300PSI IN LOW AND 7000PSI IN HIGH 40 MIN OK. STOPPED DUE TO FAILURE IN TESTING UNIT. REPAIRED FAILURE IN HYDRAULIC FLUID HOSE. ATTEMPTED TO TEST UPPER RAM PREVENTER AND BLIND RAM OBSERVING LEAK IN TEST PLUG 'O' RING. CONNECTED CUP TESTER WITH EXTENSION AND ATTEMPTED TO TEST AGAIN W/O SUCCESS, OBSERVED THAT PROPESA COMPANY TEST CUP DOES NOT PACK.

text_blocks.original_text: Resumen: SACA BNA PDC 10 5/8" + BHA DIRECCIONAL HASTA LA PROFUNDIDAD DE 1100 M, DESLIZO 16.5 M DE CABLE, VERIFICO NIVELES DE ACEITE EN CUELLO DE GANSO, SACO BNA HASTA 26 M, ESPERO POR FALLA DE GRUA, SACO BNA HASTA SUPERFICIE, DESCONECTANDO COMPONENTES DEL BHA, REALIZO ORDEN Y LIMPIEZA.
text_blocks.translated_text: Summary: PULLED OUT PDC BIT 10 5/8" + DIRECTIONAL BHA TO DEPTH OF 1100 M, SLIPPED 16.5 M OF CABLE, VERIFIED OIL LEVELS IN SWIVEL, PULLED OUT BIT TO 26 M, WAITED FOR CRANE FAILURE, PULLED OUT BIT TO SURFACE, DISCONNECTING BHA COMPONENTS, PERFORMED HOUSEKEEPING AND CLEANING.

text_blocks.original_text: SGTE. OPERACIÓN: PROBAR CONJUNTO DE PREVENTORES, ARMAR Y BAJAR BHA DIRECCIONAL CON BNA PDC 10 5/8" + AMPLIADOR RHINO HASTA 5771 M.
text_blocks.translated_text: NEXT OPERATION: TEST BOP STACK, MAKE UP AND RUN DIRECTIONAL BHA WITH PDC BIT 10 5/8" + RHINO REAMER TO 5771 M.
